text:
maria: Heads up — saw p95 spikes in eu-west-3 around 02:45 UTC. Not total outage but consistent tail blips during warm-cache windows.

sylvia: I pulled node telemetry. 4 nodes in rack-7 show NVLink retransmit bursts + egress_queue_len spikes at the same minute.

jamal: Any tenant pattern?

maria: Lots of mid-size generators aligning, shared pools. No single tenant dominates.

kevin: Trace sample req=tx-warm-88: queuing at egress proxy adds ~130ms. dmesg shows brief pci link recoveries on the affected nodes.

olga: promql you ran?

kevin: max_over_time(egress_proxy_queue_len{region="eu-west-3"}[5m]) by (node) and histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(gpu_request_seconds_bucket[1m])) by (le,node)).

sylvia: Looks like warm-kv regen -> NVLink chatter -> proxy backpressure. Multi-resource coupling.

maria: Quick mitigation idea: implement a "warmup-guard" path — tiny carved slice (2 GPUs) with node-level NIC policing + proxy token-bucket to absorb warmups. Caller opts in with X-Warmup:1 header for canary.

jamal: Scheduler bits: AllocationClass warmup-guard-ephemeral, selector gpu_role=warmup-guard, ttl 10m, preempt=false. Will pin 2 nodes in eu-west-3.

kevin: Proxy config sketch:
```
route:
  match: header("X-Warmup")=="1"
  pool: warmup-guard
  pool.qos.weight: 0.2
  pool.egress.token_rate: 60KBps
```
Node qdisc (fallback): tc qdisc tbf rate 60kbps burst 64kb

olga: SRE-bot: create alert warmup-guard-pressure (slack-only) with 2m hold.

sre-bot: Created warmup-guard-pressure alert (severity: warning), paging disabled.

kevin: I ran a short replay in staging against warmup-guard: egress p95 down ~50% vs baseline, NVLink retransmit counter reduced ~55%, median unchanged. Token throughput dropped ~3% on warmup path.

maria: Cost-wise what's the impact?

kevin: Small infra bump (~+1.5% regionally) because we reserve tiny silos. Worth it versus customer latency savings.

sylvia: Rollout plan: 1) add gpu_role=warmup-guard label to two underutilized racks, create AllocationClass, 2) deploy proxy route and SDK header in canary mode, 3) run 5% traffic canary for 30m.

jamal: Rollback gates: region_egress_p95 > baseline*1.5 OR nvlink_err_rate > 2x OR warmup-guard_queue_len > 100 for >2m. If any hit, disable route and scale allocation to 0.

olga: I'll file finance note and set a cost cap for the trial. Also notify support/product about the 5% canary.

maria: Add per-slice egress_p95 metric to console before canary so PMs can observe customer impact. Also add tenant opt-out flag.

kevin: If proxy shaping isn't enough we can escalate to NIC-level policing automatically via node agent. Phase 2: in-proxy detector for kv-miss delta to tag warmups instead of header.

sylvia: I'll prepare node tagging and perf job for the replay. Jamal please create the AllocationClass in staging.

jamal: Done in staging, labels applied. Replay job queued.

maria: Thanks. Once staging numbers are stable we'll flip the 5% canary window.
